```{r}
d <- distrito_sem |>
  mutate(
    year  = as.integer(substr(PERIODO, 1, 4)),
    month   = as.integer(substr(PERIODO, 6, 7)),
    date   = make_date(year, month, 1),
    season = case_when(month == 2 ~ "feb",
                       month == 8 ~ "aug",
                       month == 5 ~ "may", 
                       month == 11 ~ "nov"),
    PERIODO = fct_reorder(PERIODO, date)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    vt       = as.numeric(`vivienda turistica`),
    pct_vt   = as.numeric(`Porcentaje vivienda turistica`),
    plz      = as.numeric(plazas),
    plz_p_vt = as.numeric(`plazas por vivienda turistica`)
  )
```

```{r}
vt_nat <- d |>
  group_by(PERIODO, date, year) |>
  summarise(vt = sum(vt, na.rm = TRUE),
            plazas = sum(plz, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_distritos = n(), .groups = "drop")


vt_nat <- vt_nat |>
  mutate(lab = paste0(month.abb[month(date)], "\n", year(date)))

seg <- vt_nat |>
  arrange(date) |>
  mutate(xend = lead(date), yend = lead(vt),
         gap  = date == as.Date("2025-05-01")) |>   # segment May 2025 -> Nov 2025
  filter(!is.na(xend))

ggplot(vt_nat, aes(date, vt)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2025-08-01"),
             linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey60") +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2025-08-01"), y = 415000,
           label = "Aug 2025\nno data", size = 3, colour = "grey40",
           fontface = "italic", lineheight = .9) +
  geom_segment(data = seg,
               aes(x = date, y = vt, xend = xend, yend = yend, linetype = gap),
               linewidth = .9, colour = "#2C7FB8") +
  geom_point(size = 2.2, colour = "#2C7FB8") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "solid", `TRUE` = "22"),
                        guide = "none") +
  scale_x_date(breaks = vt_nat$date,
               labels = vt_nat$lab,
               expand = expansion(mult = .03)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(big.mark = ","),
                     breaks = seq(200000, 450000, by = 50000)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(200000, 420000)) +
  labs(title = "Tourist dwellings in Spain",
       subtitle = "Total over districts",
       x = NULL, y = NULL,
       caption = "Dashed line: no observation in Aug 2025 (summer peak missing).\nSource: INE, viviendas turísticas") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, lineheight = .9),
        plot.title.position = "plot")
```

Finalement ce n'est pas si grave la ≠ entre les sources de données car elles ne mesurent pas la même chose, même si c'est un peu curieux que les dynamiques soient différentes, peut-être peut-on y voir une augmentation de l'utilisation des plateformes et de la transition de logements en logements touristiques ce qui est précisément ce qu'on cherche à étudier. En ce sens la différence entre cette base et celle des hôtels / logements touristiques plus classiques peut servir d'indicateur du débordement de l'activité touristique sur le logement ? piste intéressante mais les données des logements "officiels" ne sont qu'au niveau provincial...

## Precios de vivienda 

```{r}

pmoy <- function(prix, n) {
  if (all(is.na(prix))) return(NA_real_)
  if (sum(n, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) weighted.mean(prix, n, na.rm = TRUE)
  else mean(prix, na.rm = TRUE)
}


log_nat <- d |>
  filter(!is.na(prix_sale) | !is.na(prix_rent)) |>
  group_by(PERIODO, date, season) |>
  summarise(
    prix_sale = pmoy(prix_sale, n_sale),   # pondéré par le stock de vente
    prix_rent = pmoy(prix_rent, n_rent),   # pondéré par le stock de location
    n_sale    = sum(n_sale, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_rent    = sum(n_rent, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_distritos_couverts = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# --- 1. Une ligne par distrito avec niveaux et évolutions ------------------
evol_paire <- function(data, p0, p1, min_stock = 10) {
  data |>
    filter(PERIODO %in% c(p0, p1)) |>
    mutate(t = if_else(PERIODO == p0, "0", "1")) |>
    select(CUDIS, PROV, t,
           pct  = pct_vt,
           rent = prix_rent_reel, sale = prix_sale_reel,
           n_rent, n_sale) |>
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(CUDIS, PROV), names_from = t,
                values_from = c(pct, rent, sale, n_rent, n_sale)) |>
    mutate(
      d_pct  = pct_1 - pct_0,                                   # points de %
      d_rent = if_else(n_rent_0 >= min_stock & n_rent_1 >= min_stock,
                       log(rent_1 / rent_0), NA_real_),          # ≈ % de variation
      d_sale = if_else(n_sale_0 >= min_stock & n_sale_1 >= min_stock,
                       log(sale_1 / sale_0), NA_real_)
    )
}

# --- 2. Tableau de corrélations (Spearman), brut et au sein des provinces ---
cor_tab <- function(ev, label) {
  sp <- function(x, y) cor(x, y, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
  nn <- function(x, y) sum(!is.na(x) & !is.na(y))
  ctr <- function(x) x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)

  iv <- ev |>
    group_by(PROV) |>
    mutate(across(c(pct_1, rent_1, sale_1, pct_0, d_pct, d_rent, d_sale), ctr,
                  .names = "{.col}_c")) |>
    ungroup()

  tibble(
    periodo  = label,
    relacion = c("Nivel: % VT vs alquiler", "Nivel: % VT vs venta",
                 "Δ % VT vs Δ alquiler",    "Δ % VT vs Δ venta",
                 "% VT inicial vs Δ alquiler", "% VT inicial vs Δ venta"),
    n   = c(nn(ev$pct_1, ev$rent_1), nn(ev$pct_1, ev$sale_1),
            nn(ev$d_pct, ev$d_rent), nn(ev$d_pct, ev$d_sale),
            nn(ev$pct_0, ev$d_rent), nn(ev$pct_0, ev$d_sale)),
    rho = c(sp(ev$pct_1, ev$rent_1), sp(ev$pct_1, ev$sale_1),
            sp(ev$d_pct, ev$d_rent), sp(ev$d_pct, ev$d_sale),
            sp(ev$pct_0, ev$d_rent), sp(ev$pct_0, ev$d_sale)),
    rho_intra_prov = c(sp(iv$pct_1_c, iv$rent_1_c), sp(iv$pct_1_c, iv$sale_1_c),
                       sp(iv$d_pct_c, iv$d_rent_c), sp(iv$d_pct_c, iv$d_sale_c),
                       sp(iv$pct_0_c, iv$d_rent_c), sp(iv$pct_0_c, iv$d_sale_c))
  )
}

ev_a <- evol_paire(d, "2022M08", "2024M08")
ev_b <- evol_paire(d, "2025M05", "2026M05")

resultats <- bind_rows(cor_tab(ev_a, "ago. 2022 → ago. 2024"),
                       cor_tab(ev_b, "may. 2025 → may. 2026"))

resultats |> mutate(across(c(rho, rho_intra_prov), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```
